infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Allow WomenSafty to access the camera to record video evidence during an active SOS emergency or photo reports.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Allow WomenSafty to access the microphone to record audio evidence during an active SOS emergency.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Allow WomenSafty to access your location to broadcast SOS coordinates.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: Allow WomenSafty to access your location in the background to monitor your journey and broadcast SOS coordinates even when your phone screen is locked.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: Allow WomenSafty to access your contacts to select emergency contacts for SOS alerts.
